title: MFN2–PERK Axis Regulates ER Stress in Parotid Glands of Aged Mice via MAMs
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1643-1654, November 2026.
With aging, the morphology and function of the parotid glands are impaired, and the current mechanism is unknown. The integrity of mitochondria-associated membranes (MAMs), the structure connecting mitochondria and the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), is ...
